name: vercel-orca
description: Orca plugin that runs a workspace in its own Vercel Sandbox, reached over SSH.

scripts.verify: tsc --noEmit && npm run check && npm test
scripts.build:check: npm run build && { test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- dist)" || { git status --short -- dist; echo 'dist/ differs from a fresh build: run npm run build and commit'; exit 1; }; }
